selection_prior.expected_count: season-aware uniform share of draftable or observed transferred catalog items
selection_prior.hero_pair_expected_count: sum by season of 2 * hA * hB / (3 * N concrete teams)
selection_prior.hero_skill_expected_count: sum by season of hHero * sSkill / (3 * N concrete teams)
selection_prior.relationship_adjustment: positive-only smoothed clipped log observed/expected lift

feature_families.B: activated validated named bond in one concrete team
feature_families.HC: exclusive same-camp count in one concrete team
feature_families.THS: hero and non-default skill in one concrete team
feature_families.TS3: unordered non-default skill triple in one concrete team
feature_families.TSP: unordered non-default skill pair in one concrete team
